title: Pseudoephedrine purchaser identification and logbook
rule_summary: For ordinary retail sales of scheduled listed chemical products, federal CMEA requirements generally require acceptable purchaser identification and a sales logbook; the individual-purchase logbook and ID requirement does not apply to a single sales package containing no more than 60 mg of pseudoephedrine.
exam_relevance: Tests the access-control and documentation gate separately from gram-based purchase limits.
exceptions: A single sales package containing no more than 60 mg of pseudoephedrine is excepted from the individual logbook/ID transaction requirement described by DEA.
common_confusions: Passing the daily gram limit does not by itself satisfy the separate purchaser-identification and logbook rules.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
